definitions.short: to gnaw , i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain
definitions.full: H6207. araq [ עָרַק ] verb gnaw (Arabic id. ; Syriac Pa`el); **Syriac in Lexicons, and Pa`el; but Syriac usually flee , as ᵑ7 . — Qal Participle plural צִיָּה הַעֹרְקִים Job 30:3 they who gnaw the dry (ground; figurative of scanty subsistence); suffix עֹרְקַי 30:17 my gnawing (pains) do not sleep.
